summary: Best 30.348 (r3b3_tp0 eval 4,113M; median 30.2%, 6/9 greedy episodes past 30%): the greedy line flies the human's cavity route (window -> shaft -> lower opening -> cavity -> back out -> tunnel -> room -> under *20) into the void under the room, ~70 u short of the CP2 curtain. Key finding: the 0.5/s time penalty priced the slow CP2 detour and the cavity dip below an early death; removing it (--time-pen 0 --surf-bonus 0, critic warmup) on a pit-locked checkpoint freed the greedy line within 25M steps and it learned the cavity in ~350M. Base: r2b2_sband2 + --respawn-greedy 0.15 (spawns on the policy's own greedy line before each death) + --int-real-only 1 (29.823 earlier, then pit-locked). Next: the ramp at the void's bottom up to CP2.
